attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 9.5 streaming replication across node1 (initial primary), node2, and node3 (initial standbys) on Ubuntu 16.04. Demonstrated full failover: rebooted node1 to simulate primary loss, promoted node2 (the synchronous standby, guaranteeing zero data loss) to writable primary, reattached node3 to node2, then reattached the recovered former primary node1 to node2 as a standby with all committed data intact. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on all three nodes (node1's restart doubled as the failover trigger), proving changed boot identity and full service/data/cluster-membership recovery on each. Final state: node2 is primary with node1 (sync) and node3 (async) both streaming correctly, all 3 committed rows present everywhere.
